svg.text: The update is refused; the running version keeps working.

svg.text: Draft and pre-release versions are never delivered to clients. Before the first public release the endpoint returns 404,

text.font-family: PingFang SC,Hiragino Sans GB,Microsoft YaHei,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: which the tray reports as "no update information available yet".

svg.text: Losing the signing key means no further usable updates: clients reject packages signed by a different key.
